parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main cylindrical body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the spout and switch, and contains the internal water channels and valve mechanisms.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main support structure.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the tubular part of the faucet through which water flows out, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal valve to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel in some designs to direct water flow, but in this model, it appears fixed.
